averaging: equal-weight macro across six excerpts, separately per condition
purpose: New reject-only temporal voicing experiment after failed v2. Both previous sets are development data; not independent qualification.

method.name: symmetric_acceptance_core
method.definition: Require all framewise-accepted native rows within ceil(guard_s/effective_hop_s) rows on each side, including the center. Out-of-input rows count as rejected. Zero guard reproduces v2. No gap filling, no pitch interpolation, no confidence/source/RMS threshold changes.
method.rationale: A fixed 20 ms margin tests whether local persistence suppresses short voiced islands and boundary spillover from the centered 64 ms pitch frontend. It is an engineering abstention rule, not a calibrated source detector or full-window uncertainty bound.

prospective_test.selection: First track of each next six unseen singers in numeric ID order, metadata only; no audio, annotations or model output inspected.
prospective_test.prerequisite: Both development sets must pass every original gate separately; verify replay/direct equality and independent review before test inference.

stop_rule: One fixed 20ms method, no search over margins or other parameters. If either development set fails, retain failure and do not consume fresh test. If both pass, freeze exact source/protocol and test once; no replacement test or post-result tuning. Original v2 remains a failure; this is a new experiment, not continuation of v2 qualification.
